record.name: Skilling's figure (great disnub dirhombidodecahedron)

chiralityEvidence.closureMethod: generator Cayley traversal on spanning-frame action keys
chiralityEvidence.scope: Exhausted Gram-compatible full-incidence group search for supplied approximate coordinates only.

record.sourceClassification: Attributed exceptional uniform figure with four source faces at some geometric edges; not an ordinary two-face shell.
record.catalogStatus: Attributed realization; independently checked literal regular polygons, incidence and numerical symmetry.
record.numericContract: Supplied approximate source decimals; no exact certificate
record.incidenceConvention: 240 unique source vertex-pair edges, 120 with two and 120 with four incident source faces. No abstract 360-edge pairing is guessed.

limitations: Numerical finite supplied-coordinate chirality, not an algebraic uniformity certificate.
Skilling abstract coincident-edge pairings and infinite dual are not inferred.
Reflected variants are coordinate realizations, not new combinatorial uniform types.
